zh.title: 西南航空 737-800 在洛杉磯中止起飛 隨後重新起飛
zh.summary: 飛往拉斯維加斯的 WN1121 在洛杉磯24L跑道中止起飛，數分鐘後重新離場。
body: 據 The Aviation Herald 報導，西南航空 WN1121 航班11月19日由洛杉磯飛往拉斯維加斯，執飛客機為註冊號 N8520Q 的波音737-800。航機在洛杉磯國際機場（LAX）24L跑道加速時，機組以低速中止起飛。
報導引述機組通訊稱，飛機在濕滑的跑道標線處出現輕微擺動。客機隨後離開跑道並進入平行滑行道，機組在幾分鐘後向航管表示可繼續飛行。
客機滑回等待位置後重新起飛，並按時抵達拉斯維加斯。機組對跑道狀況的描述是通訊紀錄所載，來源並未提出正式肇因。

en.title: Southwest 737-800 rejects takeoff at Los Angeles, then departs safely
en.summary: The Las Vegas-bound flight stopped during its takeoff roll and departed after returning to the holding point.
body: Southwest flight WN1121 rejected its takeoff at low speed on Los Angeles International Airport (LAX)’s runway 24L on November 19, The Aviation Herald reported. The Las Vegas-bound Boeing 737-800 was registered N8520Q.

The crew told air traffic control that the aircraft had swayed slightly on wet runway markings. The aircraft exited onto a parallel taxiway, and a few minutes later the crew reported it was ready to depart.
The aircraft returned to the holding point, took off without a further incident reported and reached Las Vegas on time. The crew’s radio description was not a formal determination of the cause.

facts.claim: The crew rejected takeoff on runway 24L at low speed.
It reported slight swaying on wet runway markings.
N8520Q departed after returning to the holding point and reached Las Vegas on time.
